verses.text: For the music director. A thoughtful psalm of the sons of Korah. As a deer longs for streams of water, so I long for you, God.
I am thirsty for God, the living God. When can I go and stand in front of God?
My tears have been my food day and night, while people keep asking me, "Where is your God?"
I remember these things as I pour out my heart: how I used to walk with the crowd, leading them to God's house, with shouts of joy and praise among the crowd celebrating a festival.
Why are you so sad, my soul? Why are you so upset inside me? Put your hope in God! I will praise him again, because he is with me and saves me.
My God, I am so sad inside. So I will remember you from the land of the Jordan River, from the peaks of Mount Hermon, from Mount Mizar.
Deep waters call out to deep waters in the roar of your waterfalls. All your waves and breakers have rolled over me.
By day the LORD sends his faithful love. At night his song is with me, a prayer to the God who gives me life.
I say to God, my rock, "Why have you forgotten me? Why must I go around crying because my enemy is crushing me?"
My enemies insult me as if they were breaking my bones. They keep asking me, "Where is your God?"
Why are you so sad, my soul? Why are you so upset inside me? Put your hope in God! I will praise him again, my saviour and my God.
